**Description**

This quick guide provides an overview landing page for the Curve Care+ Clinical AI Voice Transcription Suite.

**About**

The Curve Care+ Clinical AI Suite provides users the ability to create AI-generated note drafts from recorded provider-patient conversations, real-time clinical charting via hands-free provider voice dictation, and real-time periodontal charting via voice dictation for maximum efficiency

**Important Note:** Curve Care+ AI Voice Transcriptions require users to have Administrator permissions. Permissions can be established in _Roles and permissions_ inside the _Administration_ side panel.
